records.literal_gloss: Flee for safety, sons of Benjamin, from [the] midst of Jerusalem, and in Tekoa blow [the] trumpet, and over Beth-haccherem raise [a] signal, for evil looks down from [the] north, and destruction great.

en.L: Flee for safety, sons of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem! \q In Tekoa blow the trumpet, \q and over Beth-haccherem raise a signal! \q For disaster looks down from the north, and great destruction.
en.B: Run for safety, people of Benjamin, out from the middle of Jerusalem! \q Sound the ram's horn in Tekoa, \q lift up a signal fire over Beth-haccherem! \q For disaster is looming out of the north, a great collapse.
en.R: People of Benjamin, run away from Jerusalem to be safe! \q Blow the trumpet in the town of Tekoa. \q Light a fire on the hill of Beth-haccherem to warn people. \q Disaster is about to come from the north. Everything will be crushed.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} para ponerse a salvo, hijos de Benjamín, de en medio de Jerusalén! \q ¡En Tecoa {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} la trompeta, \q y sobre Bet-haquerem {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} una señal! \q Porque desde el norte se asoma la desgracia, y una gran destrucción.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Corran|Corred}} a ponerse a salvo, gente de Benjamín, fuera de Jerusalén! \q {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero en Tecoa, \q ¡{{plural_you:enciendan|encended}} una fogata de señal sobre Bet-haquerem! \q Porque desde el norte amenaza la desgracia, un gran desastre.
es.R: ¡Gente de Benjamín, {{plural_you:huyan|huid}} de Jerusalén para estar a salvo! \q {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta en el pueblo de Tecoa. \q {{plural_you:Enciendan|Encended}} un fuego en el monte de Bet-haquerem para avisar a la gente. \q La desgracia está a punto de llegar desde el norte. Todo será aplastado.

fr.L: Fuyez pour vous mettre à l’abri, fils de Benjamin, hors de Jérusalem ! \q À Teqoa sonnez du cor, \q et sur Beth-Hakkérem élevez un signal ! \q Car le malheur se penche du nord, et un grand désastre.
fr.B: Courez vous mettre à l’abri, gens de Benjamin, hors de Jérusalem ! \q Sonnez du cor à Teqoa, \q allumez un feu de signal sur Beth-Hakkérem ! \q Car le malheur menace du nord, un grand effondrement.
fr.R: Habitants de Benjamin, fuyez Jérusalem pour être en sécurité ! \q Sonnez de la trompette dans la ville de Teqoa. \q Allumez un feu sur la colline de Beth-Hakkérem pour avertir les gens. \q Le malheur va arriver du nord. Tout sera écrasé.

sw.L: Kimbieni mpate salama, enyi wana wa Benyamini, kutoka katikati ya Yerusalemu! \q Katika Tekoa pigeni baragumu, \q na juu ya Beth-hakeremu inueni ishara! \q Kwa maana mabaya yanachungulia kutoka kaskazini, na uharibifu mkuu.
sw.B: Kimbieni mpate usalama, enyi watu wa Benyamini, tokeni katikati ya Yerusalemu! \q Pigeni baragumu katika Tekoa, \q washeni moto wa ishara juu ya Beth-hakeremu! \q Kwa maana maafa yanakaribia kutoka kaskazini, maangamizi makuu.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Benyamini, kimbieni mtoke Yerusalemu mpate kuwa salama! \q Pigeni baragumu katika mji wa Tekoa. \q Washeni moto juu ya kilima cha Beth-hakeremu kuwaonya watu. \q Maafa yanakaribia kuja kutoka kaskazini. Kila kitu kitapondwa.

vi.L: Hãy chạy trốn cho an toàn, hỡi con cháu Bên-gia-min, ra khỏi giữa Giê-ru-sa-lem! \q Hãy thổi kèn tại Thê-cô-a, \q hãy giương tín hiệu trên Bết-Hác-kê-rem! \q Vì tai họa từ phương bắc đang nhìn xuống, và sự tàn phá lớn.
vi.B: Hỡi dân Bên-gia-min, hãy chạy ra khỏi giữa Giê-ru-sa-lem cho an toàn! \q Hãy thổi tù và tại Thê-cô-a, \q hãy đốt lửa hiệu trên Bết-Hác-kê-rem! \q Vì tai họa đang lù lù kéo đến từ phương bắc, một sự sụp đổ lớn lao.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Bên-gia-min, hãy chạy ra khỏi Giê-ru-sa-lem cho an toàn! \q Hãy thổi kèn tại thị trấn Thê-cô-a. \q Hãy đốt lửa trên đồi Bết-Hác-kê-rem để báo động cho mọi người. \q Tai họa sắp đến từ phương bắc. Mọi thứ sẽ bị nghiền nát.

ko.L: 베냐민 자손들아, 예루살렘 한가운데서 피하여라! \q 드고아에서 나팔을 불고, \q 벧학게렘 위에 신호를 올려라! \q 재앙과 큰 파멸이 북쪽에서 내려다보고 있다.
ko.B: 베냐민 사람들아, 예루살렘 한복판에서 빠져나와 피하여라! \q 드고아에서 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불고, \q 벧학게렘 위에 봉화를 올려라! \q 재앙이, 크나큰 붕괴가 북쪽에서 다가오고 있다.
ko.R: 베냐민 사람들아, 예루살렘에서 도망쳐 목숨을 건져라! \q 드고아 마을에서 나팔을 불어라. \q 벧학게렘 언덕에 불을 피워 사람들에게 위험을 알려라. \q 북쪽에서 재앙이 닥치려 한다. 모든 것이 부서질 것이다.

pt.L: Fujam para se salvar, filhos de Benjamim, do meio de Jerusalém! \q Em Tecoa toquem o chifre de carneiro, \q e sobre Bete-Haquerém levantem um sinal! \q Pois a desgraça espreita do norte, e uma grande ruína.
pt.B: Corram para se salvar, povo de Benjamim, para fora de Jerusalém! \q Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Tecoa, \q acendam uma fogueira de sinal sobre Bete-Haquerém! \q Pois a desgraça surge ameaçadora do norte, um grande desastre.
pt.R: Povo de Benjamim, fujam de Jerusalém para se salvar! \q Toquem a trombeta na cidade de Tecoa. \q Acendam uma fogueira no monte de Bete-Haquerém para avisar o povo. \q A desgraça está para chegar do norte. Tudo vai ser esmagado.

decisions.choice: Benjamin, Tekoa, Beth-haccherem: places around Jerusalem, named in the order of flight from an enemy coming from the north
decisions.reason: Jerusalem lay on the border of Benjamin, Jeremiah's own tribe (his town, Anathoth, was in Benjamin, 1:1), and many of its people were of Benjamin. Tekoa was a town in the hills about ten miles south of Jerusalem, Amos's home (Amos 1:1). Beth-haccherem was also south of the city (Nehemiah 3:14), probably on a hill where a signal could be seen. People fleeing an army from the north would run south, through these places.

decisions.choice: wordplays on the names: in Tekoa (tiqo'a) blow (tiq'u); Beth-haccherem, 'house of the vineyard'
decisions.reason: The verb "blow" sounds like the name Tekoa, so the alarm is sounded in the town whose name echoes it. Beth-haccherem means "house of the vineyard", which may look ahead to the gleaning of the vine in verse 9. The wordplay cannot be carried over, but the names are kept.

decisions.choice: trumpet ... signal: alarms of war; the signal was probably a fire or smoke signal
decisions.reason: The trumpet was a ram's horn, blown to warn of an attack (Amos 3:6; Hosea 5:8). The word for "signal" comes from the verb "lift up" and was used for a beacon of fire or smoke sent from hill to hill (Judges 20:38, 40).

decisions.choice: disaster looks down from the north: the coming invasion, pictured as looming over the land
decisions.reason: The verb means to look down from a height (Genesis 18:16; Psalm 14:2). The disaster from the north, announced at Jeremiah's call (1:13-15) and in 4:6, is an invading army. The last words, "and great destruction", stand on their own in the Hebrew, as a cry (as 4:6).

decisions.choice: ram's horn ... signal fire
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the settled wording for the trumpet (ram's horn) and says what kind of signal was meant (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: the town of Tekoa ... light a fire on the hill ... to warn people
decisions.reason: Readable explains that Tekoa is a town and what the signal was for, and puts "great destruction" as a full sentence.

decisions.choice: "Benjamín", "Tecoa", "Bet-haquerem"
decisions.reason: The places in their usual Spanish forms (Tecoa as in 2 Samuel 14:2; 2 Chronicles 20:20). The Hebrew plays on Tekoa (tiqo'a) and "blow" (tiq'u); Spanish cannot keep the sound.

decisions.choice: Tekoa, Beth-hakeremu
decisions.reason: Tekoa as 1 Chronicles 2:24; Beth-haccherem in the pattern of the published Beth- names (2 Kings 9:27). The Hebrew sound-play on the names (meaning decision m2) cannot be kept in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "Teqoa", "Beth-Hakkérem"
decisions.reason: The usual French transcription of the two towns; the play on *Tekoa* and *tiqʿu* ("blow") cannot be kept in French and is left to the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "Thê-cô-a" (2 Chronicles 11:6); "Bết-Hác-kê-rem"
decisions.reason: Tekoa as published; Beth-haccherem is new in this block and written from the Hebrew name, "house of the vineyard", keeping the article "ha" as the English form does. The Hebrew sound play on Tekoa cannot be kept (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: Tecoa; Bete-Haquerém
decisions.reason: The towns take the forms 2 Samuel 14:2 and Nehemiah 3:14 give them in Portuguese. The play on the sound of "Tekoa" and "blow" (m2) cannot be kept in Portuguese; the meaning note explains it.

source.text: הַנָּוָה֙ וְהַמְּעֻנָּגָ֔ה דָּמִ֖יתִי בַּת־צִיּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: The lovely and the delicate I will destroy, [the] daughter of Zion.

en.L: The lovely and the delicate one \q I will destroy, the daughter of Zion.
en.B: The lovely and pampered one, \q Daughter Zion, I will destroy.
en.R: The people of Zion are like a lovely, well-cared-for woman. \q But I will destroy them.

es.L: A la hermosa y delicada \q destruiré, a la hija de Sion.
es.B: A la hermosa y consentida, \q a la hija de Sion, la destruiré.
es.R: El pueblo de Sion es como una mujer hermosa y bien cuidada. \q Pero yo lo destruiré.

fr.L: La belle et la délicate, \q je la détruirai, la fille de Sion.
fr.B: La belle, la choyée, \q la fille de Sion, je la détruirai.
fr.R: Le peuple de Sion est comme une belle femme bien soignée. \q Mais je vais le détruire.

sw.L: Yule mzuri na mwororo \q nitamwangamiza, binti Sayuni.
sw.B: Yule mzuri aliyedekezwa, \q Binti Sayuni, nitamwangamiza.
sw.R: Watu wa Sayuni ni kama mwanamke mzuri aliyetunzwa vizuri. \q Lakini nitawaangamiza.

vi.L: Kẻ xinh đẹp và yêu kiều, \q Ta sẽ hủy diệt, là con gái Si-ôn.
vi.B: Kẻ xinh đẹp và được nuông chiều, \q con gái Si-ôn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt.
vi.R: Dân Si-ôn giống như một thiếu nữ xinh đẹp được chăm chút kỹ lưỡng. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt họ.

ko.L: 아름답고 곱게 자란 여자, \q 딸 시온을 내가 멸하겠다.
ko.B: 아름답고 곱게 자란 여자, \q 딸 시온을 내가 멸하겠다.
ko.R: 시온 백성은 아름답고 곱게 보살핌을 받은 여자와 같다. \q 그러나 내가 그들을 멸하겠다.

pt.L: A formosa e a delicada \q eu destruirei, a filha de Sião.
pt.B: A formosa e mimada, \q a filha de Sião, eu destruirei.
pt.R: O povo de Sião é como uma mulher bonita e bem cuidada. \q Mas eu vou destruí-lo.

decisions.choice: I will destroy
alternatives: I have likened Daughter Zion to a lovely and delicate one
I have likened Daughter Zion to a lovely pasture
decisions.reason: The verb can come from a root meaning "cut off, destroy" (as Hosea 4:5) or from one meaning "be like, compare". Read as "destroy", God speaks of the coming ruin of the city. Read as "compare", the verse says "I have likened Daughter Zion to a lovely pasture", taking the first word as "pasture" (it has that sense in 23:3; 25:30) and leading into the shepherds and flocks of verse 3. The Hebrew allows both; the sense of judgment is the same either way.

decisions.choice: lovely and delicate: beautiful and used to comfort
decisions.reason: The second word describes someone raised in ease and luxury (Deuteronomy 28:56; Isaiah 47:1). Zion is pictured as a fine, sheltered woman, about to be overrun.

decisions.choice: daughter of Zion: Jerusalem and its people, pictured as a young woman
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 1:8, "daughter" personifies the city and its people as a woman under God's care.

decisions.choice: the people of Zion are like a lovely, well-cared-for woman
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Zion", as the settled wording for this phrase, and makes the picture of a woman explicit.

source.text: אֵלֶ֛יהָ יָבֹ֥אוּ רֹעִ֖ים וְעֶדְרֵיהֶ֑ם תָּקְע֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ אֹהָלִים֙ סָבִ֔יב רָע֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־יָדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To her will come shepherds and their flocks; they will pitch against her tents all around; they will graze each [his] hand.

en.L: To her shepherds will come with their flocks; \q they will pitch tents against her all around; \q they will graze, each [in] his place.
en.B: Shepherds will come against her with their flocks; \q they will set up tents on every side of her, \q and each will graze his own patch.
en.R: Enemy kings will come against her with their armies, like shepherds with their flocks. \q They will set up their tents all around her. \q Each one will take the part he wants.

es.L: A ella vendrán pastores con sus rebaños; \q plantarán tiendas contra ella alrededor; \q apacentará cada uno [en] su lugar.
es.B: Vendrán pastores contra ella con sus rebaños; \q plantarán sus tiendas por todos sus lados, \q y cada uno apacentará su parte.
es.R: Reyes enemigos vendrán contra ella con sus ejércitos, como pastores con sus rebaños. \q Plantarán sus tiendas alrededor de ella. \q Cada uno tomará la parte que quiera.

fr.L: Vers elle viendront des bergers avec leurs troupeaux ; \q ils dresseront contre elle des tentes tout autour ; \q ils feront paître chacun [sa] part.
fr.B: Des bergers viendront contre elle avec leurs troupeaux ; \q ils planteront leurs tentes tout autour d’elle, \q et chacun fera paître son coin.
fr.R: Des rois ennemis viendront l’attaquer avec leurs armées, comme des bergers avec leurs troupeaux. \q Ils installeront leurs tentes tout autour d’elle. \q Chacun prendra la part qu’il veut.

sw.L: Kwake watakuja wachungaji pamoja na makundi yao; \q watapiga hema dhidi yake pande zote; \q watalisha, kila mmoja [mahali] pake.
sw.B: Wachungaji watakuja dhidi yake pamoja na makundi yao; \q watapiga hema pande zote kumzunguka, \q na kila mmoja atalisha sehemu yake.
sw.R: Wafalme wa adui watakuja dhidi yake na majeshi yao, kama wachungaji wanavyokuja na makundi yao. \q Watapiga hema zao pande zote kumzunguka. \q Kila mmoja atachukua sehemu anayoitaka.

vi.L: Những người chăn sẽ đến với nó cùng các bầy của họ; \q họ sẽ dựng trại vây quanh nghịch cùng nó; \q họ sẽ cho ăn cỏ, mỗi người [tại] chỗ của mình.
vi.B: Những người chăn sẽ kéo đến đánh nó cùng với bầy của họ; \q họ sẽ dựng lều khắp chung quanh nó, \q và mỗi người sẽ chăn bầy trên phần đất của mình.
vi.R: Các vua thù địch sẽ kéo quân đến đánh nó, như người chăn dẫn bầy chiên đến. \q Họ sẽ dựng lều trại khắp chung quanh nó. \q Mỗi người sẽ chiếm lấy phần mình muốn.

ko.L: 목자들이 자기 양 떼를 몰고 그 여자에게 올 것이다. \q 그들이 그 여자를 둘러싸고 장막을 칠 것이다. \q 그들이 각각 자기 자리에서 풀을 뜯길 것이다.
ko.B: 목자들이 양 떼를 몰고 그 여자를 치러 올 것이다. \q 그들이 그 여자의 사방에 장막을 치고, \q 저마다 자기 몫의 땅에서 풀을 뜯길 것이다.
ko.R: 원수의 왕들이 양 떼를 몰고 오는 목자들처럼 군대를 이끌고 그 여자를 치러 올 것이다. \q 그들은 그 여자의 사방에 장막을 칠 것이다. \q 저마다 자기가 원하는 곳을 차지할 것이다.

pt.L: A ela virão pastores com os seus rebanhos; \q armarão tendas contra ela ao redor; \q apascentarão, cada um [no] seu lugar.
pt.B: Pastores virão contra ela com os seus rebanhos; \q armarão tendas por todos os lados dela, \q e cada um pastará a sua parte.
pt.R: Reis inimigos virão contra ela com os seus exércitos, como pastores com os seus rebanhos. \q Vão armar as suas tendas em volta dela. \q Cada um vai pegar a parte que quiser.

decisions.choice: shepherds with their flocks: foreign rulers with their armies
decisions.reason: Kings and leaders are often called shepherds (2:8; 12:10; 25:34). Here enemy commanders come with their troops and camp around Jerusalem, and the flocks strip the land bare as an army does when it lays siege.

decisions.choice: hand: portion, the place each one takes
decisions.reason: "Hand" can mean a share or a space beside something (Numbers 2:17; Deuteronomy 23:13). Each commander takes his own part of the land around the city.

decisions.choice: enemy kings ... with their armies, like shepherds with their flocks
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (meaning decision m1) and keeps the shepherds as a comparison.

source.text: קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה ק֖וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה בַֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם א֥וֹי לָ֨נוּ֙ כִּי־פָנָ֣ה הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י יִנָּט֖וּ צִלְלֵי־עָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: Consecrate against her war; arise and let us go up at noon. Woe to us, for has turned the day, for are stretched out [the] shadows of evening.

en.L: "Consecrate war against her! \q Arise, and let us go up at noon!" \q "Woe to us, for the day has turned, \q for the shadows of evening are stretched out!
en.B: "Make ready a holy war against her! \q Up, let us attack at noon!" \q "Woe to us! The day is fading, \q and the evening shadows are growing long!
en.R: The enemy says, "Get ready for battle against her! \q Come on! Let us attack at noon!" \q "How terrible this is for us! The day is almost over. \q The evening shadows are getting long.

es.L: «¡{{plural_you:Consagren|Consagrad}} la guerra contra ella! \q ¡{{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}}, y subamos al mediodía!». \q «¡Ay de nosotros, porque el día declina, \q porque se alargan las sombras de la tarde!
es.B: «¡{{plural_you:Prepárense|Preparaos}} para una guerra santa contra ella! \q ¡Arriba, ataquemos al mediodía!». \q «¡Ay de nosotros! El día se va, \q y las sombras de la tarde se alargan!
es.R: El enemigo dice: «¡{{plural_you:Prepárense|Preparaos}} para la batalla contra ella! \q ¡Vamos! ¡Ataquemos al mediodía!». \q «¡Qué terrible es esto para nosotros! El día casi se acaba. \q Las sombras de la tarde se están alargando.

fr.L: « Consacrez la guerre contre elle ! \q Levez-vous, et montons en plein midi ! » \q « Malheur à nous, car le jour décline, \q car les ombres du soir s’allongent !
fr.B: « Préparez contre elle une guerre sainte ! \q Debout, attaquons en plein midi ! » \q « Malheur à nous ! Le jour baisse, \q et les ombres du soir s’allongent !
fr.R: L’ennemi dit : « Préparez-vous à combattre contre elle ! \q Allez ! Attaquons à midi ! » \q « Quel malheur pour nous ! Le jour est presque fini. \q Les ombres du soir s’allongent.

sw.L: "Takaseni vita dhidi yake! \q Inukeni, tupande adhuhuri!" \q "Ole wetu, kwa maana mchana umegeuka, \q kwa maana vivuli vya jioni vimerefuka!
sw.B: "Jiwekeni tayari kwa vita vitakatifu dhidi yake! \q Inukeni, tushambulie adhuhuri!" \q "Ole wetu! Mchana unakwisha, \q na vivuli vya jioni vinazidi kurefuka!
sw.R: Adui anasema, "Jiandaeni kwa vita dhidi yake! \q Haya! Tushambulie adhuhuri!" \q "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwetu! Mchana karibu unakwisha. \q Vivuli vya jioni vinarefuka.

vi.L: "Hãy biệt riêng cuộc chiến nghịch cùng nó! \q Hãy đứng dậy, và chúng ta hãy đi lên lúc giữa trưa!" \q "Khốn cho chúng ta, vì ngày đã xế, \q vì bóng chiều đã ngả dài!
vi.B: "Hãy chuẩn bị thánh chiến nghịch cùng nó! \q Nào, chúng ta hãy tấn công lúc giữa trưa!" \q "Khốn cho chúng ta! Ngày đã tàn, \q và bóng chiều đã ngả dài!
vi.R: Quân thù nói: "Hãy sẵn sàng giao chiến với nó! \q Nào! Chúng ta hãy tấn công lúc giữa trưa!" \q "Thật khốn khổ cho chúng ta! Ngày sắp hết rồi. \q Bóng chiều đã ngả dài.

ko.L: "그 여자를 칠 전쟁을 거룩하게 구별하여라! \q 일어나라, 우리가 한낮에 올라가자!" \q "우리에게 화가 있다! 날이 기울고 \q 저녁 그림자가 길게 드리워지는구나!
ko.B: "그 여자를 칠 거룩한 전쟁을 준비하여라! \q 일어나라, 한낮에 쳐들어가자!" \q "우리에게 화가 있다! 날이 저물어 가고 \q 저녁 그림자가 길어지는구나!
ko.R: 원수들이 말한다. "그 여자를 칠 싸움을 준비하여라! \q 자, 한낮에 쳐들어가자!" \q "우리에게 끔찍한 일이 닥쳤다! 날이 거의 저물었다. \q 저녁 그림자가 길어지고 있다.

pt.L: "Consagrem a guerra contra ela! \q Levantem-se, e subamos ao meio-dia!" \q "Ai de nós, pois o dia declina, \q pois as sombras da tarde se estendem!
pt.B: "Preparem uma guerra santa contra ela! \q De pé, vamos atacar ao meio-dia!" \q "Ai de nós! O dia está acabando, \q e as sombras da tarde estão se alongando!
pt.R: O inimigo diz: "Preparem-se para a batalha contra ela! \q Vamos! Vamos atacar ao meio-dia!" \q "Que desgraça para nós! O dia está quase no fim. \q As sombras da tarde estão ficando compridas.

decisions.choice: the attackers speak (verses 4-5)
decisions.reason: The commands and the cry "woe to us" are the voice of the enemy army, urging one another on. They want to attack at midday, and when the day runs out they resolve to attack at night (verse 5). The words are quoted as their speech.

decisions.choice: consecrate war: prepare for battle with religious rites
decisions.reason: Armies offered sacrifices and kept rules of purity before going into battle (1 Samuel 7:9; 13:9-12; Joel 4:9). The enemy treats its attack as a holy act; the reader knows that it is God who is sending it (verse 6).

decisions.choice: woe to us, the day has turned: the attackers' frustration that daylight is running out
decisions.reason: Noon was not a usual time to attack, since it was the heat of the day (2 Samuel 4:5). The attackers are so eager that they plan an assault then, and complain as the afternoon wears on.

decisions.choice: Woe to us (Balanced); How terrible this is for us (Readable)
decisions.reason: This is the book-wide wording for a cry of "woe" said of oneself, as in 4:13 and Isaiah. Here the attackers cry it, frustrated that the daylight is running out (m3).

decisions.choice: the enemy says
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: «Consagren» / «Levántense» in plural_you spans
decisions.reason: The attackers urge one another on, quoted inside the oracle; their plural commands take the plural you setting like any other.

records.literal_gloss: Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her fortresses.

en.L: Arise, and let us go up by night, \q and let us destroy her fortresses!"
en.B: Up, let us attack by night \q and destroy her strongholds!"
en.R: Come on! Let us attack at night \q and destroy her strong buildings!"

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}}, y subamos de noche, \q y destruyamos sus palacios fortificados!».
es.B: ¡Arriba, ataquemos de noche \q y destruyamos sus fortalezas!».
es.R: ¡Vamos! Ataquemos de noche \q y destruyamos sus edificios fuertes!».

fr.L: Levez-vous, et montons de nuit, \q et détruisons ses palais fortifiés ! »
fr.B: Debout, attaquons de nuit \q et détruisons ses forteresses ! »
fr.R: Allez ! Attaquons pendant la nuit \q et détruisons ses bâtiments fortifiés ! »

sw.L: Inukeni, tupande usiku, \q tuziharibu ngome zake!"
sw.B: Inukeni, tushambulie usiku \q tuziangamize ngome zake!"
sw.R: Haya! Tushambulie usiku \q tuyaharibu majengo yake imara!"

vi.L: Hãy đứng dậy, và chúng ta hãy đi lên ban đêm, \q và hãy phá hủy các thành lũy của nó!"
vi.B: Nào, chúng ta hãy tấn công ban đêm \q và phá hủy các đồn lũy của nó!"
vi.R: Nào! Chúng ta hãy tấn công ban đêm \q và phá hủy những tòa nhà kiên cố của nó!"

ko.L: 일어나라, 우리가 밤에 올라가서 \q 그 여자의 요새들을 멸하자!"
ko.B: 일어나라, 밤에라도 쳐들어가서 \q 그 여자의 요새들을 무너뜨리자!"
ko.R: 자, 밤에 쳐들어가서 \q 그 여자의 튼튼한 건물들을 부수자!"

pt.L: Levantem-se, e subamos de noite, \q e destruamos as suas fortalezas!"
pt.B: De pé, vamos atacar de noite \q e destruir as suas fortalezas!"
pt.R: Vamos! Vamos atacar de noite \q e destruir as suas construções fortes!"

decisions.choice: fortresses: the fortified buildings of the city
decisions.reason: The word means the strong, high buildings of a city, palaces and towers, the places the rich and powerful lived (17:27; Amos 1:4; Psalm 48:4).

decisions.choice: up, let us attack / come on, let us attack
decisions.reason: "Go up" is the usual verb for marching against a city. Balanced and Readable say "attack", as in verse 4.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת כִּרְת֣וּ עֵצָ֔ה וְשִׁפְכ֥וּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סֹלְלָ֑ה הִ֚יא הָעִ֣יר הָפְקַ֔ד כֻּלָּ֖הּ עֹ֥שֶׁק בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh of hosts: cut down her trees and pour out against Jerusalem a siege mound. She [is] the city to be punished; all of her [is] oppression in her midst.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: \q Cut down her trees, \q and pour out a siege mound against Jerusalem. \q This is the city to be punished; \q she is all oppression within.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: \q Cut down her trees \q and heap up a siege ramp against Jerusalem. \q This is the city marked for punishment; \q inside her is oppression and nothing else.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: \q Cut down the trees around Jerusalem. \q Pile up dirt to make a ramp against her walls. \q This city must be punished, \q because inside her people are treated cruelly everywhere.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: \q {{plural_you:Corten|Cortad}} sus árboles, \q y {{plural_you:levanten|levantad}} un terraplén contra Jerusalén. \q Esta es la ciudad que ha de ser castigada; \q toda ella es opresión por dentro.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: \q {{plural_you:Corten|Cortad}} sus árboles \q y {{plural_you:amontonen|amontonad}} una rampa de asedio contra Jerusalén. \q Esta es la ciudad señalada para el castigo; \q dentro de ella no hay más que opresión.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: \q {{plural_you:Corten|Cortad}} los árboles que rodean Jerusalén. \q {{plural_you:Amontonen|Amontonad}} tierra para hacer una rampa contra sus murallas. \q Esta ciudad tiene que ser castigada, \q porque dentro de ella se trata con crueldad a la gente por todas partes.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Coupez ses arbres, \q et versez contre Jérusalem une levée de terre. \q C’est la ville qui doit être punie ; \q tout en elle n’est qu’oppression.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : \q Abattez ses arbres \q et entassez une rampe d’assaut contre Jérusalem. \q C’est la ville désignée pour la punition ; \q au-dedans d’elle, il n’y a qu’oppression.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Coupez les arbres autour de Jérusalem. \q Entassez de la terre pour faire une rampe contre ses murailles. \q Cette ville doit être punie, \q car, à l’intérieur, partout, les gens sont traités avec cruauté.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: \q Kateni miti yake, \q mkamwage boma la kuzingira juu ya Yerusalemu. \q Huu ndio mji wa kuadhibiwa; \q ndani yake yote ni dhuluma.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: \q Kateni miti yake \q mkalundike boma la kuzingira juu ya Yerusalemu. \q Huu ndio mji uliowekwa kwa ajili ya adhabu; \q ndani yake hakuna kitu ila dhuluma.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: \q Kateni miti inayouzunguka Yerusalemu. \q Lundikeni udongo mkajenge boma juu ya kuta zake. \q Mji huu lazima uadhibiwe, \q kwa sababu ndani yake watu wanatendewa ukatili kila mahali.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: \q Hãy đốn cây của nó, \q và đổ đất đắp ụ bao vây Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Đây là thành phải bị trừng phạt; \q bên trong nó toàn là áp bức.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: \q Hãy đốn cây cối của nó \q và đắp ụ bao vây Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Đây là thành đã bị định phải chịu trừng phạt; \q bên trong nó chỉ có áp bức mà thôi.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: \q Hãy đốn những cây quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Hãy đổ đất đắp thành dốc sát tường thành. \q Thành này phải bị trừng phạt, \q vì khắp nơi trong thành, người ta bị đối xử tàn ác.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 그 여자의 나무들을 베어 \q 예루살렘을 향해 흙 언덕을 쏟아 쌓아라. \q 이 성은 벌을 받아야 할 성읍이다. \q 그 안에는 온통 억압뿐이다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 그 나무들을 베어 \q 예루살렘을 향해 공격용 언덕을 쌓아라. \q 이 성은 벌을 받기로 정해진 성읍이다. \q 그 안에는 억압밖에 없다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 예루살렘 둘레의 나무들을 베어라. \q 흙을 쌓아 그 성벽을 공격할 언덕을 만들어라. \q 이 도성은 반드시 벌을 받아야 한다. \q 그 안의 어디에서나 사람들이 잔인하게 짓밟히고 있기 때문이다.

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: \q Cortem as suas árvores, \q e derramem uma rampa de cerco contra Jerusalém. \q Esta é a cidade que deve ser castigada; \q ela toda é opressão por dentro.
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: \q Cortem as suas árvores \q e amontoem uma rampa de cerco contra Jerusalém. \q Esta é a cidade marcada para o castigo; \q dentro dela só há opressão.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: \q Cortem as árvores em volta de Jerusalém. \q Amontoem terra para fazer uma rampa contra os seus muros. \q Esta cidade tem de ser castigada, \q porque dentro dela as pessoas são tratadas com crueldade por toda parte.

decisions.choice: the LORD gives the orders to the enemy
decisions.reason: The commands to cut trees and build a siege ramp are spoken by God himself. The attackers think they are fighting their own war (verses 4-5); in truth God has summoned them to punish his city (1:15).

decisions.choice: siege mound: a ramp of earth and timber built up to the wall
decisions.reason: Besieging armies cut trees for ramps, towers and battering rams, and heaped earth into a ramp so that siege engines could reach the top of the wall (2 Samuel 20:15; 2 Kings 19:32; Ezekiel 4:2). The law forbade Israel itself to cut down fruit trees in a siege (Deuteronomy 20:19-20).

decisions.choice: the city to be punished: the city God has called to account
decisions.reason: The verb means "to visit" in the sense of calling someone to account (as verse 15). The form is unusual; the Greek translation reads it as "city of falsehood". The sense of the Hebrew as it stands is that this is the city marked out for judgment.

decisions.choice: all of her is oppression: oppression fills the city
decisions.reason: Oppression is the abuse of the weak by the strong, cheating them and taking what is theirs (7:6; 22:17). The Hebrew compresses it: the whole city is oppression.

decisions.choice: pile up dirt to make a ramp against her walls ... because ... people are treated cruelly
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a siege ramp was and says what oppression means, and adds "because" to join the two lines, which the context implies.

decisions.choice: "el SEÑOR de los ejércitos" (L); "el SEÑOR de los Ejércitos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The LORD of hosts as the terms note sets it for Spanish. God's orders to the enemy are plural and take the plural you setting.

decisions.choice: BWANA wa majeshi
decisions.reason: "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level, as the terms note sets it, where the English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies".

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The French Samuel, Psalms and 2 Kings 19:31 keep "des armées" at every level, where the English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies".

decisions.choice: 만군의 주 (Literal, Balanced); 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 주 (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for "the LORD of hosts", used through the book; in the formula the prophet speaks, so Readable has 거느리신.

source.text: כְּהָקִ֥יר בַּ֨יִר֙ מֵימֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֖ן הֵקֵ֣רָה רָעָתָ֑הּ חָמָ֣ס וָ֠שֹׁד יִשָּׁ֨מַע בָּ֧הּ עַל־פָּנַ֛י תָּמִ֖יד חֳלִ֥י וּמַכָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: As keeps fresh a well its waters, so she keeps fresh her evil; violence and destruction is heard in her; before my face continually [are] sickness and wound.

en.L: As a well keeps its waters fresh, \q so she keeps her evil fresh; \q violence and destruction are heard in her; before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face continually are sickness and wounds.
en.B: As a well keeps its water fresh, \q so she keeps her wickedness flowing. \q Violence and ruin echo in her streets; sickness and wounds are always before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: A well always has fresh water coming into it. \q In the same way, Jerusalem always has new evil coming out of her. \q People there cry out, "Violence! Destruction!" I always see her people sick and wounded.

es.L: Como un pozo mantiene frescas sus aguas, \q así mantiene ella fresca su maldad; \q violencia y destrucción se oyen en ella; delante de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro continuamente hay enfermedad y heridas.
es.B: Como un pozo mantiene fresca su agua, \q así mantiene ella su maldad siempre fluyendo. \q La violencia y la ruina resuenan en sus calles; la enfermedad y las heridas están siempre delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: Un pozo siempre tiene agua fresca que le entra. \q De la misma manera, de Jerusalén siempre sale maldad nueva. \q La gente allí grita: «¡Violencia! ¡Destrucción!». Yo siempre veo a su gente enferma y herida.

fr.L: Comme un puits garde ses eaux fraîches, \q ainsi elle garde sa méchanceté fraîche ; \q violence et dévastation s’entendent en elle ; devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face continuellement [sont] maladies et plaies.
fr.B: Comme un puits garde son eau fraîche, \q ainsi elle fait jaillir sa méchanceté. \q Violence et ruine résonnent dans ses rues ; maladies et blessures sont toujours devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Un puits a toujours de l’eau fraîche qui arrive. \q De la même façon, Jérusalem a toujours du mal nouveau qui sort d’elle. \q Là-bas, les gens crient : « Violence ! Destruction ! » Je vois toujours ses habitants malades et blessés.

sw.L: Kama kisima kinavyoyaweka maji yake safi, \q ndivyo anavyouweka uovu wake mbichi; \q dhuluma na uharibifu vinasikika ndani yake; mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} daima kuna ugonjwa na majeraha.
sw.B: Kama kisima kinavyoyaweka maji yake safi, \q ndivyo anavyoufanya uovu wake uendelee kububujika. \q Dhuluma na uharibifu vinavuma katika njia zake; ugonjwa na majeraha viko mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} daima.
sw.R: Kisima kina maji mapya yanayoingia ndani yake daima. \q Vivyo hivyo Yerusalemu ina uovu mpya unaotoka ndani yake daima. \q Watu humo wanalia, "Dhuluma! Uharibifu!" Daima ninaona watu wake wakiwa wagonjwa na wenye majeraha.

vi.L: Như giếng giữ cho nước mình tươi mát, \q nó cũng giữ cho điều ác mình tươi mới như vậy; \q tiếng bạo lực và tàn phá được nghe trong nó; bệnh tật và thương tích luôn ở trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Như giếng giữ cho nước luôn tươi mát, \q nó cũng giữ cho sự gian ác của nó tuôn chảy mãi. \q Tiếng bạo lực và tàn phá vang khắp các đường phố nó; bệnh tật và thương tích luôn ở trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Giếng luôn có nước mới chảy vào. \q Cũng vậy, Giê-ru-sa-lem luôn có điều ác mới tuôn ra. \q Người ta trong thành kêu lên: "Bạo lực! Tàn phá!" Ta luôn thấy dân của thành ấy đau ốm và bị thương tích.

ko.L: 우물이 그 물을 신선하게 지키듯이 \q 그 여자는 자기 악을 신선하게 지킨다. \q 폭력과 파괴가 그 안에서 들리고, 병과 상처가 늘 내 앞에 있다.
ko.B: 샘이 물을 계속 솟아나게 하듯이 \q 그 여자는 악을 계속 솟아나게 한다. \q 그 거리에는 폭력과 파괴의 소리가 울리고, 병들고 상처 입은 모습이 늘 내 앞에 있다.
ko.R: 우물에는 언제나 새 물이 솟아 들어온다. \q 그와 마찬가지로 예루살렘에서는 언제나 새로운 악이 솟아 나온다. \q 그곳 사람들은 "폭력이다! 파괴다!" 하고 부르짖는다. 나는 늘 그곳 백성이 병들고 다친 모습을 본다.

pt.L: Como um poço mantém frescas as suas águas, \q assim ela mantém fresca a sua maldade; \q violência e destruição se ouvem nela; diante da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} face continuamente [estão] doença e feridas.
pt.B: Como um poço mantém fresca a sua água, \q assim ela mantém a sua maldade sempre correndo. \q Violência e ruína ecoam nas suas ruas; doenças e feridas estão sempre diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.R: Um poço sempre tem água fresca entrando nele. \q Do mesmo modo, Jerusalém sempre tem maldade nova saindo dela. \q As pessoas ali gritam: "Violência! Destruição!" Eu sempre vejo o seu povo doente e ferido.

decisions.choice: a well
decisions.reason: The written text and the reading the scribes marked for reading aloud differ in spelling between two forms of the word for a cistern or well. The reading aloud is followed; both mean a source of water.

decisions.choice: keeps fresh: keeps water cool and flowing
decisions.reason: The verb is used only here. It seems to mean to keep water cool and fresh, as a spring-fed well does. Jerusalem's evil never goes stale; it is always new, as if from a spring.

decisions.choice: violence and destruction are heard in her: the cry of people who are wronged
decisions.reason: "Violence and destruction" was the cry of victims calling for help (20:8; Habakkuk 1:2-3). The city is full of the sounds of oppression.

decisions.choice: sickness and wounds before my face: God sees the harm done to the people
decisions.reason: The sickness and wounds are the injuries the powerful inflict on the weak, and the wounds the people bring on themselves by their sin (verse 14; 10:19). God sees them always.

decisions.choice: new evil coming out of her ... people there cry out, "Violence! Destruction!"
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the comparison, names Jerusalem, and puts the sounds heard in the city as the cry of the people (meaning decision m3).

source.text: הִוָּסְרִי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם פֶּן־תֵּקַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֖י מִמֵּ֑ךְ פֶּן־אֲשִׂימֵ֣ךְ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ ל֥וֹא נוֹשָֽׁבָה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Be warned, Jerusalem, lest be torn my soul from you, lest I make you a desolation, a land not inhabited.

en.L: Be warned, Jerusalem, \q lest {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul be torn away from you, \q lest I make you a desolation, \q a land not inhabited.
en.B: Take correction, Jerusalem, \q or I will turn from you in disgust, \q and make you a wasteland, \q a land where no one lives.
en.R: People of Jerusalem, listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} warning! \q If you do not, I will turn away from you. \q I will make your land empty, \q and no one will live there.

es.L: Escarmienta, Jerusalén, \q no sea que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma se aparte de ti, \q no sea que te convierta en desolación, \q en tierra no habitada.
es.B: Acepta la corrección, Jerusalén, \q o me apartaré de ti con repugnancia, \q y te convertiré en un desierto, \q en una tierra donde nadie vive.
es.R: ¡Gente de Jerusalén, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} advertencia! \q Si no {{plural_you:lo hacen|lo hacéis}}, me apartaré de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \q Dejaré {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}} vacía, \q y nadie vivirá allí.

fr.L: Laisse-toi avertir, Jérusalem, \q de peur que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme ne se détache de toi, \q de peur que je ne fasse de toi une désolation, \q un pays inhabité.
fr.B: Accepte la leçon, Jérusalem, \q sinon je me détournerai de toi avec dégoût, \q et je ferai de toi un désert, \q un pays où personne n’habite.
fr.R: Habitants de Jérusalem, écoutez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} avertissement ! \q Sinon, je me détournerai de vous. \q Je viderai votre pays, \q et personne n’y habitera plus.

sw.L: Onyeka, Yerusalemu, \q nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} isije ikatengwa nawe, \q nisije nikakufanya ukiwa, \q nchi isiyokaliwa.
sw.B: Kubali kurudiwa, Yerusalemu, \q la sivyo nitakuacha kwa chukizo, \q na kukufanya kuwa jangwa, \q nchi ambayo hakuna mtu anayeishi.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Yerusalemu, sikilizeni onyo {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}! \q Msiposikiliza, nitawaacha. \q Nitaifanya nchi yenu kuwa tupu, \q wala hakuna mtu atakayeishi humo.

vi.L: Hãy chịu sửa dạy, hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q kẻo linh hồn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lìa khỏi ngươi, \q kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho ngươi thành hoang vu, \q một xứ không người ở.
vi.B: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy chịu sửa dạy, \q kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghê tởm mà lìa bỏ ngươi, \q và làm cho ngươi thành hoang địa, \q một xứ không ai ở.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy nghe lời cảnh cáo của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Nếu không, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quay lưng lìa bỏ ngươi. \q Ta sẽ làm cho xứ ngươi trống không, \q và không ai sống ở đó nữa.

ko.L: 예루살렘아, 경고를 받아라. \q 그렇지 않으면 내 영혼이 너에게서 떨어져 나가, \q 내가 너를 황무지로, \q 사람이 살지 않는 땅으로 만들 것이다.
ko.B: 예루살렘아, 훈계를 받아들여라. \q 그렇지 않으면 내가 너를 싫어하여 돌아서고, \q 너를 황무지로, \q 아무도 살지 않는 땅으로 만들겠다.
ko.R: 예루살렘 사람들아, 내 경고를 들어라! \q 그렇지 않으면 내가 너희에게서 돌아서겠다. \q 내가 너희 땅을 텅 비게 만들겠다. \q 그곳에는 아무도 살지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Deixa-te corrigir, Jerusalém, \q para que a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} alma não se arranque de ti, \q para que eu não te faça uma desolação, \q uma terra não habitada.
pt.B: Aceita a correção, Jerusalém, \q senão eu vou {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} afastar de ti com repugnância \q e te transformar num deserto, \q uma terra onde ninguém mora.
pt.R: Jerusalém, escuta o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} aviso! \q Se não escutares, eu vou {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} afastar de ti. \q Vou fazer da tua terra um lugar vazio, \q e ninguém vai morar ali.

decisions.choice: be warned: accept discipline and correction
decisions.reason: The verb means to let oneself be taught or corrected, as a child by a parent (2:30; 31:18). It is a last appeal before judgment.

decisions.choice: lest my soul be torn from you: lest God turn away from Jerusalem in revulsion
decisions.reason: "Soul" here is God's very self. The verb means to be wrenched or pulled away (Ezekiel 23:17-18, of turning away in disgust). God warns that his patience with the city may break and he may turn from it altogether.

decisions.choice: turn from you in disgust / turn away from you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the picture of the soul being torn away as God turning away, which is its meaning (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "Gente de Jerusalén, escuchen"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable speaks to the people of the city, Spanish Readable addresses them in the plural, with the plural you setting; Literal and Balanced speak to Jerusalem as "tú".

decisions.choice: Jerusalém, escuta (tu)
decisions.reason: The command is to the city as one woman (feminine singular), so Readable keeps "tu" and the city's name, as the other levels do, where the English Readable says "People of Jerusalem"; Portuguese "tu" already makes the address personal.

source.text: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עוֹלֵ֛ל יְעוֹלְל֥וּ כַגֶּ֖פֶן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָשֵׁב֙ יָדְךָ֔ כְּבוֹצֵ֖ר עַל־סַלְסִלּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: thoroughly they will glean like a vine [the] remnant of Israel; pass again your hand like a grape-gatherer over [the] branches.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: \q They will glean thoroughly, as [from] a vine, the remnant of Israel; \q pass your hand again, like a grape gatherer, over the branches.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: \q They will glean the remnant of Israel as bare as a vine. \q Reach out your hand again like one picking grapes, \q over the branches.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: \q The enemy will pick the people of Israel clean, like grapes left on a vine. \q Go over the branches again, \q like someone picking grapes.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: \q Rebuscarán del todo, como [en] una vid, el remanente de Israel; \q vuelve a pasar tu mano, como el vendimiador, por los sarmientos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: \q Rebuscarán al remanente de Israel hasta dejarlo como una vid pelada. \q Vuelve a extender tu mano, como quien recoge uvas, \q sobre los sarmientos.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: \q El enemigo dejará limpio al pueblo de Israel, como las uvas que quedan en una vid. \q Vuelve a pasar por las ramas, \q como alguien que recoge uvas.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q On grappillera entièrement, comme une vigne, le reste d’Israël ; \q repasse ta main, comme le vendangeur, sur les sarments.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : \q On grappillera le reste d’Israël jusqu’au dernier grain, comme une vigne. \q Repasse la main comme celui qui vendange \q sur les sarments.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q L’ennemi ramassera tout ce qui reste du peuple d’Israël, comme les derniers raisins d’une vigne. \q Repasse sur les branches, \q comme quelqu’un qui cueille le raisin.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: \q Watayaokota kabisa, kama [kutoka] mzabibu, mabaki ya Israeli; \q pitisha mkono wako tena, kama mchuma zabibu, juu ya matawi.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: \q Wataokota mabaki ya Israeli mpaka yaishe kama mzabibu uliochumwa. \q Nyosha mkono wako tena kama mtu anayechuma zabibu, \q juu ya matawi.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: \q Adui atawachuma watu wa Israeli mpaka wasibaki, kama zabibu zilizobaki mzabibuni. \q Pitia matawi tena, \q kama mtu anayechuma zabibu.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: \q Chúng sẽ mót sạch như [mót] cây nho, những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q hãy đưa tay ngươi lại lần nữa, như người hái nho, trên các nhánh.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: \q Chúng sẽ mót sạch những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên như mót trụi cây nho. \q Hãy đưa tay ra lần nữa như người hái nho \q lướt trên các nhánh.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: \q Quân thù sẽ hái sạch dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, như hái những trái nho còn sót trên cây. \q Hãy lướt qua các nhánh một lần nữa, \q như người hái nho vẫn làm.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 그들이 이스라엘의 남은 자를 포도나무처럼 샅샅이 주울 것이다. \q 포도 따는 사람처럼 가지들 위로 네 손을 다시 뻗어라.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 그들이 이스라엘의 남은 사람들을 포도나무 이삭 줍듯이 남김없이 거둘 것이다. \q 포도 따는 사람처럼 다시 손을 뻗어 \q 가지들을 훑어라.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 적이 포도나무에 남은 포도를 따듯이 이스라엘 백성을 남김없이 거두어 갈 것이다. \q 포도 따는 사람처럼 \q 가지들을 다시 훑어라.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: \q Respigarão completamente, como [a] uma videira, o remanescente de Israel; \q passa de novo a tua mão, como o vindimador, sobre os ramos.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: \q O remanescente de Israel será rebuscado como uma videira, até não sobrar nada. \q Estende de novo a mão como quem colhe uvas \q sobre os ramos.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: \q O inimigo vai pegar até o último do povo de Israel, como as uvas que sobram numa videira. \q Passa de novo pelos ramos, \q como quem colhe uvas.

decisions.choice: glean thoroughly: strip the vine of the last grapes left after the harvest
decisions.reason: After the grape harvest the poor were allowed to gather what was left (Leviticus 19:10; Deuteronomy 24:21). Here the gleaners leave nothing. Even the remnant, the few left after earlier invasions, will be taken (compare 49:9).

decisions.choice: pass your hand again: a command to the one doing the gleaning
decisions.reason: The verb is a command to one person. It may be addressed to the enemy, told to go over the vine again, or to the prophet, told to search the people once more for any who are faithful (5:1). The picture of judgment is the same either way.

decisions.choice: the remnant of Israel: the people of Judah who are left
decisions.reason: The northern kingdom had already fallen to Assyria. "Israel" here is the people of God left in Judah.

decisions.choice: the enemy will pick the people of Israel clean
decisions.reason: Readable names the enemy as the ones gleaning and says "the people of Israel" for "the remnant of Israel".

decisions.choice: "el remanente de Israel" (L, B); "el pueblo de Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: Remnant (she'ar) as the terms note sets it for Spanish.

decisions.choice: mabaki ya Israeli
decisions.reason: Remnant is "mabaki" at Literal and Balanced and "watu waliobaki" at Readable, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại" (Literal, Balanced); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for the remnant (she'erit), as 2 Kings 19:4, 31; Readable names the people, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: 남은 자 (Literal); 남은 사람들 (Balanced); Readable names the people
decisions.reason: *sheʾerit* follows the terms note's wording for the remnant at each level.

decisions.choice: o remanescente de Israel (L, B)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: she'erit, the people left after judgment, is "o remanescente" at Literal and Balanced, the word the prophets have in Portuguese (Romans 11:5; Ezra 9:8); Readable says who they are, as the English Readable does. "Resto" can sound like leftovers.

source.text: עַל־מִ֨י אֲדַבְּרָ֤ה וְאָעִ֨ידָה֙ וְיִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הִנֵּה֙ עֲרֵלָ֣ה אָזְנָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֑יב הִנֵּ֣ה דְבַר־יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ־בֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To whom will I speak and warn, that they may hear? Look, uncircumcised [is] their ear, and not they are able to pay attention. Look, [the] word of Yahweh has become to them a reproach; not they delight in it.

en.L: To whom shall I speak and give warning, that they may hear? \q Look, their ear is uncircumcised, \q and they are not able to pay attention. \q Look, the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has become to them a reproach; they do not delight in it.
en.B: Who is there for me to speak to and warn, so that they will listen? \q Their ears are uncircumcised; \q they cannot pay attention. \q The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has become something they mock; they take no pleasure in it.
en.R: Is there anyone I can talk to and warn? Will anyone listen? \q Their ears are closed, \q so they cannot hear. \q They laugh at the message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They do not want it at all.

es.L: ¿A quién hablaré y advertiré, para que oigan? \q Mira, su oído es incircunciso, \q y no pueden prestar atención. \q Mira, la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se ha vuelto para ellos una afrenta; no se complacen en ella.
es.B: ¿A quién puedo hablar y advertir para que escuchen? \q Sus oídos son incircuncisos; \q no pueden prestar atención. \q La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se ha convertido en algo de lo que se burlan; no les agrada.
es.R: ¿Hay alguien con quien pueda hablar y a quien pueda advertir? ¿Escuchará alguien? \q Tienen los oídos cerrados, \q por eso no pueden oír. \q Se ríen del mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. No lo quieren para nada.

fr.L: À qui parlerai-je et qui avertirai-je, pour qu’ils entendent ? \q Voici, leur oreille est incirconcise, \q et ils ne peuvent pas être attentifs. \q Voici, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est devenue pour eux un opprobre ; ils n’y prennent pas plaisir.
fr.B: À qui puis-je parler, qui puis-je avertir, pour qu’on m’écoute ? \q Leurs oreilles sont incirconcises ; \q ils sont incapables d’être attentifs. \q La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est devenue pour eux un objet de moquerie ; ils n’y trouvent aucun plaisir.
fr.R: Y a-t-il quelqu’un à qui je puisse parler et que je puisse avertir ? Quelqu’un va-t-il écouter ? \q Leurs oreilles sont fermées, \q alors ils ne peuvent pas entendre. \q Ils se moquent du message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils n’en veulent pas du tout.

sw.L: Nimwambie nani na kumwonya, ili wasikie? \q Tazama, sikio lao halijatahiriwa, \q wala hawawezi kusikiliza. \q Tazama, neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limekuwa kwao aibu; hawalifurahii.
sw.B: Ni nani niwezaye kumwambia na kumwonya ili asikilize? \q Masikio yao hayajatahiriwa; \q hawawezi kusikiliza. \q Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limekuwa kitu wanachokidhihaki; hawalipendi hata kidogo.
sw.R: Je, kuna mtu yeyote ninayeweza kumwambia na kumwonya? Je, kuna atakayesikiliza? \q Masikio yao yamefungwa, \q kwa hiyo hawawezi kusikia. \q Wanaucheka ujumbe kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hawautaki kabisa.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ nói với ai và cảnh cáo ai, để họ nghe? \q Kìa, tai họ không được cắt bì, \q và họ không thể chú ý. \q Kìa, lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã trở nên điều sỉ nhục cho họ; họ không ưa thích lời ấy.
vi.B: Tôi còn biết nói với ai và cảnh cáo ai để họ chịu nghe? \q Tai họ chưa được cắt bì; \q họ không thể để tâm nghe. \q Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thành điều họ chế giễu; họ chẳng thích thú gì lời ấy.
vi.R: Có ai để tôi nói chuyện và cảnh cáo không? Có ai chịu nghe không? \q Tai họ đã đóng lại, \q nên họ không thể nghe. \q Họ chế nhạo sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ chẳng muốn nghe chút nào.

ko.L: 내가 누구에게 말하고 경고하여 그들이 듣게 하겠느냐? \q 보아라, 그들의 귀가 할례를 받지 않아서 \q 그들이 귀를 기울일 수 없다. \q 보아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 그들에게 조롱거리가 되었다. 그들은 그것을 기뻐하지 않는다.
ko.B: 내가 누구에게 말하고 경고해야 그들이 듣겠느냐? \q 그들의 귀는 할례를 받지 않아서 \q 귀를 기울이지 못한다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀은 그들에게 비웃음거리가 되었다. 그들은 그 말씀을 조금도 반기지 않는다.
ko.R: 내가 말하고 경고할 사람이 누구냐? 누가 듣겠느냐? \q 그들의 귀는 막혀 있어서 \q 듣지 못한다. \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 말씀을 비웃는다. 그들은 그 말씀을 전혀 원하지 않는다.

pt.L: A quem falarei e advertirei, para que ouçam? \q Eis que o seu ouvido está incircunciso, \q e não conseguem prestar atenção. \q Eis que a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se tornou para eles uma vergonha; não têm prazer nela.
pt.B: A quem eu posso falar e advertir, para que escutem? \q Os seus ouvidos são incircuncisos; \q eles não conseguem prestar atenção. \q A palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} virou para eles motivo de zombaria; não sentem nenhum prazer nela.
pt.R: Existe alguém com quem eu possa falar e a quem eu possa avisar? Alguém vai escutar? \q Os ouvidos deles estão fechados, \q por isso não conseguem ouvir. \q Eles riem da mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Não a querem de jeito nenhum.

decisions.choice: the prophet speaks
decisions.reason: The "I" here is Jeremiah. Sent to warn the people, he asks whether anyone will listen. In verse 11 he says he is full of God's anger, and God answers him.

decisions.choice: their ear is uncircumcised: their ears are closed, unable to receive God's word
decisions.reason: Circumcision was the sign of belonging to God's covenant (Genesis 17:10-11). An uncircumcised ear is one that has not been opened to God, as if covered over, so that his word cannot get in. Jeremiah uses the same picture of the heart (4:4; 9:25), and Stephen joins the two (Acts 7:51).

decisions.choice: a reproach: something scorned and mocked
decisions.reason: The word means disgrace, an object of contempt. The people treat God's word as a joke (20:8).

decisions.choice: uncircumcised
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture because Jeremiah uses it of the heart as well (4:4; 9:25) and the New Testament takes it up (Acts 7:51). Readable gives its meaning, "closed".

decisions.choice: "incircunciso"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture of the uncircumcised ear, as the English does; Readable says what it means.

source.text: וְאֵת֩ חֲמַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה׀מָלֵ֨אתִי֙ נִלְאֵ֣יתִי הָכִ֔יל שְׁפֹ֤ךְ עַל־עוֹלָל֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְעַ֛ל ס֥וֹד בַּחוּרִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־גַם־אִ֤ישׁ עִם־אִשָּׁה֙ יִלָּכֵ֔דוּ זָקֵ֖ן עִם־מְלֵ֥א יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] wrath of Yahweh I am full [of]; I am weary of holding in. Pour out on [the] child in the street and on [the] gathering of young men together; for also husband with wife will be taken, old with full of days.

en.L: But I am full of the wrath of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I am weary of holding [it] in. \q Pour [it] out on the child in the street, \q and on the gathering of young men together; \q for both husband with wife will be taken, \q the old with the one full of days.
en.B: But I am filled with the fury of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I am worn out from holding it back. \q Pour it out on the little ones in the street \q and on the young men where they gather; \q for husband and wife alike will be captured, \q the elderly and those who have lived out their years.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s anger fills me. I am tired of keeping it inside. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says: Pour it out on the children playing in the street \q and on the young men standing together. \q Husbands and wives will be taken away. \q So will old people and those who are very old.

es.L: Pero yo estoy lleno de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; estoy cansado de contener[la]. \q Derrámala sobre el niño en la calle, \q y sobre la reunión de los jóvenes a la vez; \q porque tanto el marido con la mujer serán apresados, \q el anciano con el lleno de días.
es.B: Pero estoy lleno del furor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; estoy agotado de contenerlo. \q Derrámalo sobre los pequeños en la calle \q y sobre los jóvenes donde se reúnen; \q porque el marido y la mujer serán capturados por igual, \q los ancianos y los que han llegado al final de sus años.
es.R: Pero la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} me llena. Estoy cansado de guardarla dentro. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice: Derrámala sobre los niños que juegan en la calle \q y sobre los jóvenes que están reunidos. \q Los maridos y las esposas serán llevados. \q También los viejos y los que son muy ancianos.

fr.L: Mais je suis plein de la fureur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; je suis las de [la] contenir. \q Répands-[la] sur l’enfant dans la rue, \q et sur le groupe des jeunes gens réunis ; \q car le mari avec la femme seront pris, \q le vieillard avec celui qui est rassasié de jours.
fr.B: Mais je suis rempli de la fureur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; je suis épuisé de la retenir. \q Répands-la sur les petits enfants dans la rue \q et sur les jeunes gens rassemblés ; \q car le mari et la femme seront capturés, \q les vieillards et ceux qui ont vécu tous leurs jours.
fr.R: Mais la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me remplit. Je suis fatigué de la garder en moi. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : Répands-la sur les enfants qui jouent dans la rue \q et sur les jeunes gens qui sont ensemble. \q Les maris et les femmes seront emmenés. \q Les personnes âgées et les très vieilles aussi.

sw.L: Lakini nimejaa ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nimechoka kuizuia. \q Imwage juu ya mtoto barabarani, \q na juu ya kusanyiko la vijana pamoja; \q kwa maana mume pamoja na mke watatwaliwa, \q mzee pamoja na aliyejaa siku.
sw.B: Lakini nimejaa ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nimechoka kuizuia. \q Imwage juu ya watoto wadogo barabarani \q na juu ya vijana mahali wanapokusanyika; \q kwa maana mume na mke watachukuliwa mateka pamoja, \q wazee na wale walioishi siku zao zote.
sw.R: Lakini hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} imenijaa. Nimechoka kuiweka ndani yangu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema: Imwage juu ya watoto wanaocheza barabarani \q na juu ya vijana waliosimama pamoja. \q Waume na wake zao watachukuliwa. \q Vivyo hivyo wazee na wale walio wazee sana.

vi.L: Nhưng tôi đầy dẫy cơn thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; tôi mệt mỏi vì phải cầm giữ [nó]. \q Hãy đổ [nó] ra trên đứa trẻ ngoài đường, \q và trên đám thanh niên tụ họp với nhau; \q vì cả chồng lẫn vợ đều sẽ bị bắt, \q người già cùng với người đã đầy tuổi.
vi.B: Nhưng tôi đầy dẫy cơn thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; tôi đã mỏi mệt vì cố kìm giữ nó. \q Hãy đổ nó ra trên những trẻ nhỏ ngoài đường \q và trên đám thanh niên nơi họ tụ tập; \q vì cả chồng lẫn vợ đều sẽ bị bắt, \q người già cả và người đã sống trọn tuổi đời.
vi.R: Nhưng cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy trong tôi. Tôi đã mệt vì cứ phải giữ nó trong lòng. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Hãy đổ nó ra trên trẻ con đang chơi ngoài đường \q và trên các thanh niên đang đứng tụ tập. \q Chồng và vợ sẽ bị bắt đi. \q Người già và người rất già cũng vậy.

ko.L: 그러나 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 분노로 가득 차서 그것을 참기에 지쳤다. \q 거리에 있는 아이에게, \q 함께 모인 젊은이들에게 그것을 쏟아라. \q 남편도 아내와 함께 잡혀갈 것이고, \q 노인도 나이가 찬 자와 함께 [잡혀갈 것이다].
ko.B: 그러나 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노로 가득 차서 그것을 억누르기에 지쳤다. \q 거리의 어린아이들에게, \q 모여 있는 젊은이들에게 그것을 쏟아부어라. \q 남편도 아내도 붙잡혀 갈 것이고, \q 노인들도, 나이가 아주 많은 사람들도 그러할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 분노가 내 속에 가득하다. 나는 그것을 속에 담아 두기가 힘들다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신다. 거리에서 노는 아이들에게, \q 함께 서 있는 젊은이들에게 그것을 쏟아라. \q 남편과 아내가 끌려갈 것이다. \q 노인들과 아주 나이 많은 사람들도 끌려갈 것이다.

pt.L: Mas estou cheio do furor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; estou cansado de contê-[lo]. \q Derrama [o furor] sobre a criança na rua \q e sobre o grupo de jovens reunidos; \q pois tanto o marido com a mulher serão apanhados, \q o velho com o cheio de dias.
pt.B: Mas estou cheio da fúria {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; estou esgotado de tanto contê-la. \q Derrama-a sobre os pequenos na rua \q e sobre os jovens onde se reúnem; \q pois marido e mulher serão capturados, \q os idosos e os que já viveram muitos anos.
pt.R: Mas a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} me enche. Estou cansado de guardá-la dentro de mim. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Derrama essa ira sobre as crianças que brincam na rua \q e sobre os jovens que estão juntos. \q Os maridos e as mulheres vão ser levados embora. \q E também os velhos e os muito velhos.

decisions.choice: the prophet speaks first, then God answers
alternatives: I am weary of holding it in, and of pouring it out on the child in the street
decisions.reason: "I am full" and "I am weary" are Jeremiah's words: God's anger at the people burns in him as God's word does (20:9). The command "pour it out" is God's reply, telling the prophet to announce the judgment on everyone. The verb can also be read "to pour it out", continuing the prophet's words ("I am weary of holding it in, of pouring it out"), but the form is a command.

decisions.choice: the wrath of the LORD: God's burning anger at sin
decisions.reason: The word is used of hot anger, like poison or fire (4:4; 7:20). It is God's holy anger against the evil of his people, which the prophet carries as his message.

decisions.choice: child ... young men ... husband and wife ... old ... full of days: every age of life
decisions.reason: The list runs from small children to the very old. "Full of days" means someone who has lived a long life (Genesis 25:8; 35:29). No one in the city will escape.

decisions.choice: the LORD says
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who gives the command (meaning decision m1), and adds "playing" and "standing" to make the scenes clear.

decisions.choice: captured / taken away
decisions.reason: The verb means to be caught, as in a trap or in war. Balanced and Readable make clear that the people will be taken by the enemy.

source.text: וְנָסַ֤בּוּ בָֽתֵּיהֶם֙ לַאֲחֵרִ֔ים שָׂד֥וֹת וְנָשִׁ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־אַטֶּ֧ה אֶת־יָדִ֛י עַל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be turned over their houses to others, fields and wives together; for I will stretch out my hand against [the] inhabitants of the land, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And their houses will be turned over to others, \q fields and wives together; \q for I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against the inhabitants of the land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Their houses will pass to others, \q their fields and their wives too; \q for I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against the people of the land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Other people will take their houses, \q their fields and their wives. \q I will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power to punish the people who live in this land, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y sus casas pasarán a otros, \q campos y mujeres a la vez; \q porque extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra los habitantes de la tierra, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Sus casas pasarán a otros, \q y también sus campos y sus mujeres; \q porque extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra los habitantes del país, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Otros se quedarán con sus casas, \q con sus campos y con sus esposas. \q Usaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder para castigar a la gente que vive en esta tierra, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et leurs maisons passeront à d’autres, \q les champs et les femmes ensemble ; \q car j’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre les habitants du pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Leurs maisons passeront à d’autres, \q avec leurs champs et leurs femmes ; \q car j’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre les habitants du pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: D’autres prendront leurs maisons, \q leurs champs et leurs femmes. \q J’emploierai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance pour punir les gens qui vivent dans ce pays, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na nyumba zao zitapewa wengine, \q mashamba na wake pamoja; \q kwa maana nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya wakaaji wa nchi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nyumba zao zitakuwa mali ya wengine, \q mashamba yao na wake zao pia; \q kwa maana nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya watu wa nchi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu wengine watazichukua nyumba zao, \q mashamba yao na wake zao. \q Nitatumia uwezo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kuwaadhibu watu wanaoishi katika nchi hii, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Nhà cửa chúng sẽ bị chuyển sang cho người khác, \q cả ruộng đất lẫn vợ; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra nghịch cùng dân cư trong xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Nhà cửa chúng sẽ thuộc về người khác, \q ruộng đất và vợ chúng cũng vậy; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra nghịch cùng dân trong xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Người khác sẽ chiếm lấy nhà cửa của chúng, \q ruộng đất và vợ của chúng. \q Ta sẽ dùng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để trừng phạt những người sống trong xứ này, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 집이 남들에게 넘어갈 것이다. \q 밭과 아내들도 함께 [넘어갈 것이다]. \q 내가 이 땅의 주민들을 향해 내 손을 뻗을 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그들의 집이 남의 손에 넘어가고, \q 그들의 밭과 아내들도 그렇게 될 것이다. \q 내가 이 땅의 백성을 향해 손을 뻗겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 다른 사람들이 그들의 집을 차지할 것이다. \q 그들의 밭과 아내들도 차지할 것이다. \q 내가 내 힘으로 이 땅에 사는 사람들을 벌하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E as suas casas passarão a outros, \q os campos e as mulheres juntamente; \q pois estenderei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra os habitantes da terra, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: As suas casas passarão para outros, \q e também os seus campos e as suas mulheres; \q pois estenderei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra o povo da terra, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Outras pessoas vão tomar as suas casas, \q os seus campos e as suas mulheres. \q Vou usar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder para castigar os que moram nesta terra, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: houses, fields and wives given to others: the curse for breaking the covenant
decisions.reason: The Law warned that a disobedient people would see their houses, vineyards and wives taken by others (Deuteronomy 28:30). Verses 12-15 are repeated, with small changes, in 8:10-12.

decisions.choice: stretch out my hand against: act in power to strike
decisions.reason: God's outstretched hand brought plagues on Egypt (Exodus 7:5) and is now turned against his own people (21:5; Isaiah 5:25).

decisions.choice: I will use my power to punish
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom of the stretched-out hand (meaning decision m2).

source.text: כִּ֤י מִקְּטַנָּם֙ וְעַד־גְּדוֹלָ֔ם כֻּלּ֖וֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וּמִנָּבִיא֙ וְעַד־כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלּ֖וֹ עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: For from their least and to their greatest, all of him [is] gaining unjust gain; and from prophet and to priest, all of him [is] doing falsehood.

en.L: For from their least and to their greatest, \q every one of them is gaining unjust gain; \q and from prophet and to priest, \q every one of them practices falsehood.
en.B: For from the smallest of them to the greatest, \q all are out for dishonest gain; \q from prophet to priest, \q every one of them deals in lies.
en.R: Everyone wants to get rich by cheating others, \q from the least important person to the most important. \q Even the prophets and the priests \q all tell lies.

es.L: Porque desde el más pequeño de ellos hasta el más grande, \q cada uno de ellos busca ganancia injusta; \q y desde el profeta hasta el sacerdote, \q cada uno de ellos practica el engaño.
es.B: Porque desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande, \q todos buscan ganancias deshonestas; \q desde el profeta hasta el sacerdote, \q todos practican la mentira.
es.R: Todos quieren enriquecerse engañando a los demás, \q desde el menos importante hasta el más importante. \q Hasta los profetas y los sacerdotes, \q todos dicen mentiras.

fr.L: Car depuis leur plus petit jusqu’à leur plus grand, \q chacun d’eux est avide de gain ; \q et depuis le prophète jusqu’au prêtre, \q chacun d’eux pratique le mensonge.
fr.B: Car du plus petit au plus grand, \q tous ne cherchent qu’un gain malhonnête ; \q du prophète au prêtre, \q tous trafiquent du mensonge.
fr.R: Tout le monde veut s’enrichir en trompant les autres, \q des gens les moins importants jusqu’aux plus importants. \q Même les prophètes et les prêtres \q disent tous des mensonges.

sw.L: Kwa maana tangu mdogo wao hata mkubwa wao, \q kila mmoja wao anapata faida isiyo ya haki; \q na tangu nabii hata kuhani, \q kila mmoja wao anatenda uongo.
sw.B: Kwa maana tangu aliye mdogo kati yao hadi aliye mkubwa, \q wote wanatafuta faida ya udanganyifu; \q tangu nabii hadi kuhani, \q kila mmoja wao anafanya uongo.
sw.R: Kila mtu anataka kutajirika kwa kuwadanganya wengine, \q tangu mtu asiye na cheo hadi mwenye cheo kikubwa. \q Hata manabii na makuhani \q wote wanasema uongo.

vi.L: Vì từ kẻ nhỏ nhất đến kẻ lớn nhất trong chúng, \q ai nấy đều tham lợi bất chính; \q từ nhà tiên tri đến thầy tế lễ, \q ai nấy đều làm điều giả dối.
vi.B: Vì từ người nhỏ nhất đến người lớn nhất, \q ai cũng chạy theo lợi bất chính; \q từ nhà tiên tri đến thầy tế lễ, \q ai cũng làm điều dối trá.
vi.R: Ai cũng muốn làm giàu bằng cách lừa gạt người khác, \q từ người thấp kém nhất đến người quyền thế nhất. \q Ngay cả các nhà tiên tri và các thầy tế lễ \q đều nói dối cả.

ko.L: 그들 가운데 가장 작은 자부터 가장 큰 자까지 \q 모두가 부당한 이득을 탐하고, \q 예언자부터 제사장까지 \q 모두가 거짓을 행한다.
ko.B: 그들은 작은 사람부터 큰 사람까지 \q 모두 부정한 이익을 노리고, \q 예언자부터 제사장까지 \q 모두 거짓을 일삼는다.
ko.R: 모두가 남을 속여서 부자가 되려고 한다. \q 가장 하찮은 사람부터 가장 높은 사람까지 그렇다. \q 예언자들과 제사장들까지도 \q 모두 거짓말을 한다.

pt.L: Pois desde o menor deles até o maior, \q cada um deles busca lucro injusto; \q e desde o profeta até o sacerdote, \q cada um deles pratica a falsidade.
pt.B: Pois, do menor ao maior, \q todos estão atrás de lucro desonesto; \q do profeta ao sacerdote, \q todos negociam com mentiras.
pt.R: Todos querem ficar ricos enganando os outros, \q desde a pessoa menos importante até a mais importante. \q Até os profetas e os sacerdotes, \q todos contam mentiras.

decisions.choice: from their least to their greatest: everyone, of every rank
decisions.reason: The pair names the two ends of society, the humble and the powerful, to include everyone between (31:34; 42:1). Even the leaders who should guide the people are corrupt.

decisions.choice: gaining unjust gain: seeking profit by any means
decisions.reason: The noun means profit got by violence or dishonesty (22:17; Ezekiel 22:27). The repeated root stresses greed: everyone grabs what they can.

decisions.choice: practices falsehood: deals deceitfully, and speaks lies
decisions.reason: "Falsehood" covers both dishonest dealing and false words. In Jeremiah the word is used often of prophets who speak lies in God's name (5:31; 14:14; 23:25). The next verse gives an example of their lies.

decisions.choice: verses 13-15 are repeated in 8:10-12
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 8:10-12 repeats these lines almost word for word. The repetition shows that this was a charge the prophet brought more than once.

decisions.choice: all are out for dishonest gain / wants to get rich by cheating others
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the repeated root ("gaining gain") as the greed it describes.

decisions.choice: the same Swahili at each level in 8:10-12
decisions.reason: Verses 13-15 return almost word for word in 8:10-12; the Swahili of each level is kept the same there.

decisions.choice: verses 13-15 worded to serve 8:10-12 as well
decisions.reason: Verses 13-15 return almost word for word in 8:10-12 (m4). Where the Hebrew is the same there, its Portuguese should take these sentences level by level ("do menor ao maior", "lucro desonesto", "Paz, paz", "cairão com os que caem"), and change only where the Hebrew does.

source.text: וַֽיְרַפְּא֞וּ אֶת־שֶׁ֤בֶר עַמִּי֙ עַל־נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵאמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם׀שָׁל֑וֹם וְאֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they have healed [the] fracture of my people lightly, saying, Peace, peace, and there is no peace.

en.L: And they have healed the fracture of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people lightly, \q saying, "Peace, peace," \q and there is no peace.
en.B: They have treated the fracture of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people as though it were slight, \q saying, "Peace, peace," \q when there is no peace.
en.R: My people are badly hurt, but the leaders treat the wound as if it were only a scratch. \q They say, "Peace, peace!" \q But there is no peace.

es.L: Y curan la herida de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo a la ligera, \q diciendo: «Paz, paz», \q y no hay paz.
es.B: Tratan la fractura de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo como si fuera algo leve, \q diciendo: «Paz, paz», \q cuando no hay paz.
es.R: Mi pueblo está gravemente herido, pero los dirigentes tratan la herida como si fuera solo un rasguño. \q Dicen: «¡Paz, paz!». \q Pero no hay paz.

fr.L: Et ils ont soigné à la légère la fracture de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q en disant : « Paix, paix », \q et il n’y a pas de paix.
fr.B: Ils ont traité la fracture de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple comme si elle était sans gravité, \q en disant : « Paix, paix », \q alors qu’il n’y a pas de paix.
fr.R: Mon peuple est gravement blessé, mais les chefs soignent la blessure comme si c’était une simple égratignure. \q Ils disent : « La paix, la paix ! » \q Mais il n’y a pas de paix.

sw.L: Nao wameliponya jeraha la watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa juu juu, \q wakisema, "Amani, amani," \q wala hakuna amani.
sw.B: Wamelitibu jeraha la watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kana kwamba ni dogo, \q wakisema, "Amani, amani," \q wakati hakuna amani.
sw.R: Watu wangu wameumia vibaya, lakini viongozi wanalitibu jeraha kana kwamba ni mkwaruzo tu. \q Wanasema, "Amani, amani!" \q Lakini hakuna amani.

vi.L: Chúng đã chữa vết thương của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cách qua loa, \q mà nói: "Bình an, bình an," \q nhưng chẳng có bình an.
vi.B: Chúng chữa vết gãy của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như thể đó là chuyện nhỏ, \q mà nói: "Bình an, bình an," \q trong khi chẳng có bình an.
vi.R: Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bị thương nặng, nhưng các nhà lãnh đạo lại xem vết thương ấy như vết trầy nhẹ. \q Chúng nói: "Bình an, bình an!" \q Nhưng chẳng có bình an nào cả.

ko.L: 그들이 내 백성의 상처를 가볍게 치료하면서 \q "평안하다, 평안하다" 하고 말하지만 \q 평안이 없다.
ko.B: 그들은 내 백성의 상처를 대수롭지 않게 여겨 대충 싸매면서 \q "평안하다, 평안하다" 하고 말한다. \q 그러나 평안은 없다.
ko.R: 내 백성은 크게 다쳤는데, 지도자들은 그 상처를 작은 생채기처럼 다룬다. \q 그들은 "평안하다! 평안하다!" 하고 말한다. \q 그러나 평안은 없다.

pt.L: E trataram a fratura do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo como coisa leve, \q dizendo: "Paz, paz", \q e não há paz.
pt.B: Trataram a fratura do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo como se fosse leve, \q dizendo: "Paz, paz", \q quando não há paz.
pt.R: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo está muito ferido, mas os líderes tratam a ferida como se fosse só um arranhão. \q Eles dizem: "Paz, paz!" \q Mas não há paz.

decisions.choice: the fracture of my people: the nation's deep injury, a broken bone
decisions.reason: The word means a break, a fracture of a bone or a breaking of a nation (4:6; 8:21; 10:19). The people's sin and the disaster coming on them are a deep wound; the prophets and priests of verse 13 treat it as if it were nothing.

decisions.choice: lightly: as a trifling matter
decisions.reason: The form means "something slight". They give the wound a quick, careless dressing, as if it were not serious.

decisions.choice: peace: safety, everything well, no disaster coming
decisions.reason: Peace here is well-being and safety: no war, no judgment. The false prophets promise it in God's name (14:13; 23:17), while God is sending an army from the north. The same words return in 8:11.

decisions.choice: Peace, peace, when there is no peace: repeated in 8:11 and echoed by Ezekiel
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 8:11 repeats this verse, with "the daughter of my people" in place of "my people". Ezekiel brings the same charge against the prophets who say "Peace" when there is none (Ezekiel 13:10, 16).

decisions.choice: my people are badly hurt, but the leaders treat the wound as if it were only a scratch
decisions.reason: Readable names the prophets and priests of verse 13 as "the leaders", and states the people's hurt before the careless healing, so that the comparison is clear.

decisions.choice: peace (not "all is well")
decisions.reason: "Peace" is kept at every level, since it is the word the prophets promised and the saying is repeated in 8:11. The same wording is used there at each level.

decisions.choice: "Paz, paz ... y no hay paz" (L); "cuando no hay paz" (B); "Pero no hay paz" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording at each level for this line and its repeat in 8:11, as the English Jeremiah note asks.

decisions.choice: Amani, amani
decisions.reason: "Amani" at every level, the same word as the peace of the whole Bible; the same wording returns in 8:11.

decisions.choice: "« Paix, paix », et il n’y a pas de paix" (L); "alors qu’il n’y a pas de paix" (B); "« La paix, la paix ! » Mais il n’y a pas de paix" (R)
decisions.reason: "Paix" is kept at every level, as the English keeps "peace", and 8:11 repeats this wording at each level.

decisions.choice: "Bình an, bình an ... chẳng có bình an"
decisions.reason: "Bình an" is the style guide's key term for peace (shalom); the saying is worded the same at each level here and in 8:11.

decisions.choice: "평안하다, 평안하다" ... 평안이 없다
decisions.reason: *shalom* is 평안 here, as the English keeps "peace"; each level keeps one wording for this saying here and in 8:11, where it returns.

decisions.choice: a fratura (L, B); Paz, paz ... não há paz (every level)
decisions.reason: The word is a broken bone (m1), so Literal and Balanced say "fratura", and 8:21 and 10:19, where the people's injury returns, should say the same; Readable says "ferida", as the English Readable says "wound". "Paz" is kept at every level, the word the prophets promised (r-en-2), and 8:11 repeats each level's wording.

source.text: הֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא־יֵב֗וֹשׁוּ גַּם־הַכְלִים֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָכֵ֞ן יִפְּל֧וּ בַנֹּפְלִ֛ים בְּעֵת־פְּקַדְתִּ֥ים יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Were they ashamed that abomination they have done? Also be ashamed not they are ashamed, also to blush not they know. Therefore they will fall among the falling; at [the] time I visit them they will stumble, says Yahweh.

en.L: Were they ashamed when they did abomination? \q No, they were not at all ashamed, and they did not know how to blush. \q Therefore they will fall among those who fall; \q at the time I punish them they will stumble, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Were they ashamed when they did such detestable things? \q Not in the least; they have forgotten how to blush. \q So they will fall with the fallen; \q when I call them to account they will be brought down, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: They have done disgusting things. Do they feel ashamed? \q No, not at all! They have not even learned how to blush. \q That is why they will die with all the others who die. \q When I punish them, they will fall, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: ¿Se avergonzaron cuando hicieron abominación? \q No, no se avergonzaron en absoluto, ni supieron sonrojarse. \q Por tanto caerán entre los que caen; \q en el tiempo en que los castigue tropezarán, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¿Se avergonzaron cuando hicieron cosas tan detestables? \q En lo más mínimo; ya no saben lo que es sonrojarse. \q Por eso caerán con los caídos; \q cuando les pida cuentas serán derribados, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Han hecho cosas repugnantes. ¿Sienten vergüenza? \q ¡No, para nada! Ni siquiera han aprendido a sonrojarse. \q Por eso morirán con todos los demás que mueran. \q Cuando los castigue, caerán, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Ont-ils eu honte d’avoir commis une abomination ? \q Non, ils n’ont pas du tout eu honte, et ils ne savent pas rougir. \q C’est pourquoi ils tomberont parmi ceux qui tombent ; \q au temps où je les visiterai, ils trébucheront, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
